name: rectangle-copy
description: Hold Alt and drag to select a rectangle (e.g. a single table column) and copy it as text - browser extension for Brave, Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers
author: pitprivel

scripts.pack:store: node scripts/check-release.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --store && node scripts/pack.mjs --store
scripts.test: node test/unit.test.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --test && node test/e2e.test.mjs
